description: K₂NaH₅(CO₄)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. K is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to two H and eight O atoms. There is one shorter (2.76 Å) and one longer (2.91 Å) K-H bond length. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.71-3.09 Å. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted corner-sharing NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.57 Å. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.26-1.36 Å. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.29 Å) and one longer (1.30 Å) C-O bond length. There are three inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent K and two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.07 Å) and one longer (1.39 Å) H-O bond length. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one K and one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent K, one Na, and two H atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, one Na, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent K, two equivalent Na, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, one Na, one C, and one H atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent K, one C, and one H atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two equivalent K and one C atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two equivalent K and one C atom.
